title: Field types and values: why “42” and 42 fit differently
goal: Read actual metadata types and distinguish the Новая enumeration value from identically named text.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P3. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: Two values can look identical on screen while metadata permits particular types. Separate the description of allowed values from an actual value and check the difference without changing the schema.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Enumerations define finite values
paragraphs: New, InProgress andClosed are developer-defined states changed through configuration, so an enumeration suits them. User-maintained services suit a catalog. Do not choose enumeration merely because today’s list is short; consider who changes it and how.

The function reads document attributes and two type descriptions. СодержитТип checks permitted customer-reference and numeric types. ТипЗнч separately examines the type of the actual Новая value as an enumeration reference for request statuses. The string "Новая" remains text despite a familiar caption.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The worked example reads real document attribute types and the type of an enumeration value. The string “Новая” does not become an enumeration value through matching spelling. Type checks do not replace range constraints or business rules.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: An empty value needs meaning
paragraphs: A new request may default toNew; an older missing status may need handling. Never silently treat empty asClosed. Distinguish absence, an allowed enumeration value and a similar-looking string. Strong typing helps, but transition correctness remains an application rule.

Separate a field’s permitted type, a variable’s actual value type and a domain constraint. A number does not prove the 0..1440 range, and an enumeration type does not prove a legal transition from a closed state. This experiment inspects types without changing existing statuses or validation.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The string “Новая” is spelled like the Новая enumeration value. Do their types match?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Metadata describes the field, while an actual value has its own type. Matching presentation does not convert one into the other. Choose the proper enumeration value before assigning it to the attribute.

sections.title: Transitions form a directed graph
paragraphs: New → InProgress andInProgress → Closed may be allowed; Closed → New may require a special command. Enforce the allowed-pair table centrally, not only through button availability. Adding a state requires updating transitions, filters, reports and tests or the new value may be mishandled.

Enumeration values are defined by the configuration developer. Users select them instead of creating catalog-like items. User-configurable states require another model and integrity rules. Do not delete referenced enumeration values just to change a caption.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The new task goes from the Комментарий type description to the input value’s type. Number and string look similar but give different answers. Neither the field nor the inputs are rewritten.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Comparing only Строка(Значение) can confuse different types. Check membership with the attribute’s type description and the value’s actual type. Validate the content separately: a valid type alone does not prove valid data.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Compatibility checks old data
paragraphs: After changing enumeration values, check existing documents and saved report settings. Renaming an element technically differs from relabeling its synonym. Do not delete an in-use value for cosmetic reasons. Preserve prior references and test an invalid transition without a write.

All four original expectations are true. The incorrect control asks for String instead of Number for minutes: it compiles but its claim is false. That tests expected-type meaning, not a complete migration, status-transition graph or all stored data.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Write a function that reads the document’s Комментарий attribute type and checks whether it includes the supplied value’s type. Compare the number 42 with the string “42”. Show both results and the preserved original string. Do not alter metadata to obtain a desired answer or write these probe values to documents.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Read metadata in your training copy and compare every labelled assertion with your prediction. These functions create no records and change no attribute types; remove only the added startup call after the experiment.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Explain metadata, a value’s type, and business validity as separate matters.
